userStories.title: Add confidence variance tracking to MatchResult
acceptanceCriteria: Add confidence_variance field to MatchResult in src/utils.py
Track variance of top-N candidate scores when multiple candidates have similar scores
Calculate variance as std_dev of top 5 candidate similarities in TieredMatcher
Add variance to match result JSON output in checkpoint
Add unit test in tests/test_confidence_variance.py verifying variance is calculated
Test that high variance (> 0.1) indicates uncertain match
userStories.notes: Added confidence_variance field to MatchResult dataclass. Implemented _calculate_confidence_variance() in TieredMatcher using statistics.stdev() on top-5 candidates. Added variance to checkpoint JSON serialization in MatchStage. Created 21 comprehensive tests in 6 test classes. High variance (>0.1) indicates uncertain match; low variance indicates clear winner.

userStories.title: Add semantic distance-based topic penalty
acceptanceCriteria: Update compute_topic_penalty in src/topic_extraction.py to use semantic similarity
Replace fixed -0.15 penalty with scaled penalty based on topic embedding distance
Use embedding model to compute topic similarity when LLM client available
Fall back to keyword overlap when embeddings unavailable
Add unit test in tests/test_topic_penalty_semantic.py for scaled penalty
Test that related topics (earthquake/disaster) get lower penalty than unrelated (earthquake/cooking)
userStories.notes: Added embedding_provider parameter to compute_topic_penalty(). Created _compute_semantic_topic_penalty() that uses cosine_similarity from embeddings module with threshold-based penalty scaling (>=0.8: 0, 0.6-0.8: small, 0.4-0.6: medium, <0.4: high penalty). Created _compute_keyword_topic_penalty() for fallback. Added 33 comprehensive tests in 11 test classes covering signature, semantic scaling, related vs unrelated topics, keyword fallback, and edge cases. All tests pass.

userStories.notes: Created MatchQualityMetrics dataclass with avg_confidence, min_confidence, max_confidence, confidence_std, gap_count, match_rate, total_segments, matched_segments. userStories.title: Add LLM reasoning quality validation
acceptanceCriteria: Add validate_llm_reasoning() function in src/matching/llm_providers.py
Check that LLM reasoning mentions specific keywords from voiceover or video
Flag low-quality reasoning that is generic (< 3 specific references)
Log warning when LLM provides generic reasoning
Add unit test in tests/test_llm_reasoning_validation.py for reasoning checks
Test that generic reasoning like 'good match' is flagged vs specific reasoning
userStories.notes: Added validate_llm_reasoning() function with ReasoningValidation dataclass. Implemented _extract_keywords() helper to parse keywords from text. Added GENERIC_REASONING_PHRASES constant for detecting generic phrases like 'good match', 'topic match'. Function checks that LLM reasoning contains at least 3 specific keyword references from voiceover or video text. Logs warning for generic or low-quality reasoning. Created 46 comprehensive tests in 10 test classes covering function signature, dataclass structure, generic detection, specific validation, warning logging, threshold customization, keyword extraction, and real-world examples. All tests pass.

userStories.title: Add temporal coherence scoring for adjacent segments
acceptanceCriteria: Add compute_temporal_coherence() function in src/matching/scoring.py
Score based on visual/topic similarity to previous segment's match
Apply small boost (+0.05) for clips from same source video as adjacent segments
Apply penalty (-0.05) for jarring context switches
Add temporal_coherence_enabled config option (default: true)
Add unit test in tests/test_temporal_coherence.py for coherence scoring
userStories.notes: Added compute_temporal_coherence() function in src/matching/scoring.py. Added _is_jarring_context_switch() helper. Added temporal_coherence_enabled, temporal_coherence_same_source_boost, temporal_coherence_context_switch_penalty to MatchingConfig. Function applies +0.05 boost for same-source videos as adjacent, -0.05 penalty for jarring context switches (no topic/keyword overlap). Created 38 comprehensive tests in 11 test classes covering function signature, config options, same-source boost, context switch penalty, helper function, edge cases, mixed scenarios, reason format, real config integration, and logging. All tests pass.
